_doc: What you read into the voice recorder (voice/server.py). One entry per voice; each line is one take; "try" is what voice/clone.py has the AI copy say, with its Chatterbox settings (exaggeration: how expressive, cfg: how closely it follows the pace of your recording). A line with "room": true records 3 s of silence (the room's own sound). Change names or lines here, or point install.py at another file with --script (example-voices.json has two made-up character voices), then run voice/install.py again; finished recordings are kept, matched by voice id and line number.

voices.name: Your voice
voices.direction: Your normal voice, like you're telling a friend about something cool. Don't perform it.

try.text: Hey, it's me. This voice was made on my own PC from a couple of minutes of recordings. Pretty wild, right?
